consent.title: Cookies
consent.description: May we measure how this site is used, with Google Analytics? It sets cookies and sends Google your visit. Nothing is measured unless you accept, and you can change your mind any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: You'll sign in with your organization's account.

errors.Expired: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
errors.RateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.Unavailable: The sign-in service isn't reachable right now. Try again later.
errors.default: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.

home.headline: Book with confidence
home.text: The simplest way to manage your bookings. Schedule, track, and organize all your appointments in one place.

scheduling.title: Easy Scheduling

availability.title: Real-time Availability
availability.text: See available time slots instantly and never double-book again.

confirmation.title: Instant Confirmation
confirmation.text: Get immediate booking confirmations and reminders for your appointments.
